title: Alef (strength, God) pointing to a monarch's crown
summary: The letter alef (א), with its ox-head pictograph meaning "strength, God" and value 1, is linked by a red arrow to the crown on a coronation portrait of a queen.

letters.meaning: strength, God (ox head pictograph); linked to a crown

pictures.description: Colour coronation portrait of a queen seated in a palace setting, wearing a jewelled imperial crown and an ermine-trimmed robe, holding a long golden sceptre in one hand and a jewelled orb in the other. A red arrow points from the letter alef to the crown.
Ancient (paleo-)Hebrew pictograph of the letter alef: an ox head with two horns, drawn in black above a short blue line.
